goal: Build the v3 lexical metrics layer (metrics/lexical/). Port the legacy lexical compute (src/slop/lexicon: affix FCA/Levenshtein clustering, actions, filters, profile, clusters) into redesign/src/slop/metrics/lexical/ behind a Lexical.over(region) view (parallel to Structure), consuming the scope tree (_ast_node/_content/_grammar) + component.lexicon(). Provide named_entities, token_locations, frequency_head, first_param_clusters, packets/packet_isolates, callables. Tests green before any lexical rule. Legacy src/slop/lexicon + src/slop/linter/rules/{stutter,sprawl,verbosity,hammers,imposters,slackers} as oracle.

summary.title: Build the v3 lexical metrics layer (metrics/lexical/)
summary.what: Stood up metrics/lexical/ — the linguistic twin of metrics/structural. Ported the self-contained compute (affix: token-Levenshtein affix patterns + FCA concepts + inheritance lattice + sprawl_over; filters: packet class-ownership) and profile (body Jaccard, receiver-call density, modal overlap on raw nodes). Built a v3-native Lexical.over(region) view computing from the scope tree: named_entities, callables, files, token_locations, frequencies, frequency_head, callable_token_bags, packets, packet_isolates, first_param_clusters (+profile via a v3 clusters.py). records.py carries NamedEntity/FirstParameterCluster. 13 tests across 4 files. Suite 139->152.
summary.why: The 6 lexical rules need entity/parameter/body structure and AST body signals the pure-token Lexicon kernel deliberately does not carry. A Lexical view over the region (Structure pattern) is the architecturally-consistent home; the kernel stays pure.

decisions.point: Where the lexical compute lives (goal said 'extend Lexicon kernel')
decisions.chose: A Lexical.over(region) view in metrics/lexical/, not the Lexicon kernel
decisions.rationale: The v3 Lexicon is a pure token-space kernel (built from (text,role,span), no AST). named_entities/first_param_clusters need entity/parameter/body structure — putting them on the kernel breaks its charter. The Structure pattern (view over region) is the consistent home; token_locations/frequency_head also live on the view, over the entity+param vocabulary (legacy semantics), not the body-inclusive kernel bag.
rejected: Bloat the Lexicon kernel with AST-dependent methods (breaks the pure-kernel sever)

decisions.chose: Port profile.py near-verbatim operating on raw tree-sitter nodes via Callable._node
decisions.rationale: The legacy profile already uses raw node API; v3 exposes the raw node, so no Node-proxy rewrite needed.
rejected: Rewrite against the v3 Node proxy (unnecessary churn)

decisions.chose: Degrade gracefully (empty parameter_types; region-wide hapax approximation)
decisions.rationale: Callable.parameters() carries no annotations and the pure-kernel Lexicon has no cheap per-scope slice; both only modulate confidence, not core detection.
rejected: Block the layer on adding annotation retention + per-scope lexicon slicing
